desc:
🍦 Welcome to Steal Ice Cream from Kids! 🍦
Steal an eight-year old's ice cream and start running! Survive as long as possible and earn points and gems for how long you survived! 😎

💸 Use GEMS for UPGRADES and POINTS for SKINS and WORLDS!
📈 Show off your points and flex on others!
👍 Favorite the game & turn on notifications to stay updated!
🎁 LIKE the game + Join the group for 1,000 FREE points!
👥 Play with friends for even more fun!

⭐ This game is purely fictional and is meant for entertainment purposes only.
